projects.title: KVRX Radio App
projects.description: The app's purpose is to make it easier for Android mobile devices to listen to the radio station and hopefully contribute to the diversity of the listener's music taste. Our application goes through the KVRX website and gathers the internet stream and other data, such as track, artists, and album name. In conjunction our app would use the LastFM API to gather information about the artist, such as the bio and genre of music.
